---
name: curation-entry
description: Add an open programming resource to Ventura OpenSource with purpose audience and canonical upstream identified. Use when extending the repository's open learning material index. Do not use when importing an upstream repository or relicensing external code.
---

# Curation entry

- Verify the upstream resource and canonical source before adding it.
- State the intended learner or developer outcome.
- Record the upstream license when it materially affects reuse.
- Prefer links over copied content unless adaptation is justified and permitted.
- Avoid duplicates forks and mirrors when the canonical project is available.
- Keep repository descriptions factual and concise.
